title: Read PR fields from context.payload.pull_request in patch.js instead of re-fetching them
answers: why does patch.js not call pulls.get anymore
how do I get the PR body, author or labels in a github-script workflow
avoid redundant GitHub API calls in workflow scripts
patch release label bot still runs after removing API lookups
body:
Convention: in `.github/workflows/patch.js` the PR body, author (`user`), `labels` and `number` come from `context.payload.pull_request`, destructured at the top of `module.exports`.
Do not add `github.rest.pulls.get` or `github.rest.issues.listLabelsOnIssue` calls to re-read data the triggering `pull_request` event already carries.
Label lookups use the payload `labels` array (`labels.find(...)` against `versionLabelPattern`), and `addLabels` uses `issue_number: pull_number`.
Bot filtering (`user.type` equal to bot, except `Copilot`) and the early return for `branch-X.Y` bases are kept on the payload fields.
Constraint: the payload is a snapshot taken when the event fired, so a label added or edited afterwards will not be seen; this is inferred from the event model, not stated in the PR.
Release listing still needs an API call; only PR and label reads were removed.
applies: Applies to github-script workflow files for pull_request-triggered jobs that only need PR metadata; not to events that lack the payload field.
says: The patch release bot is making redundant API requests to inspect pull requests.
Speed up pull request automation by reading metadata directly from the event payload.
The automated release labeler ignored labels that were added after the workflow triggered.
Ensure pull request labeling bots ignore automated accounts except for Copilot.
Skip patch release checks automatically for maintenance branch pull requests.
search: In .github/workflows/patch.js, read pull request fields including body, author, labels, and number directly from context.payload.pull_request rather than re-fetching them with github.rest.pulls.get or github.rest.issues.listLabelsOnIssue. Use the payload labels array against versionLabelPattern for label matching, use issue_number: pull_number for addLabels, and retain bot filtering (except Copilot) and branch-X.Y early returns on payload fields. Applies to github-script workflows triggered by pull_request events needing PR metadata, with the constraint that the payload snapshot does not reflect subsequent label edits and release listing still requires an API call.
